                # H1: 均值相等检验 (t检验)
                subset_sales = subset_data['Sales'].values
                if len(subset_sales) > 1:
                    # 两独立样本t检验，比较子集均值与全局均值
                    # 注意：由于我们只有全局样本均值，没有全局原始数据，这里使用单样本t检验

                    # 效应大小：Cohen's d

                else:

                # H2: 方差相等检验 (F检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 1 and global_sales_var > 0:
                    # 计算子集方差

                    else:

                else:
                    f_stat_h2, p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H3: 分布匹配检验 (Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验)
                subset_profit = subset_data['Profit'].values
                if len(subset_profit) > 0 and len(global_profit_dist) > 0:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3 = stats.ks_2samp(subset_profit, global_profit_dist)
                    # 效应大小：KS统计量本身
                    effect_size_h3 = ks_stat_h3
                else:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3, effect_size_h3 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H4: 独立性检验 (卡方检验)

                # 由于需要分类变量，我们将profit分为分位数
                if len(subset_profit) > 0:
                    # 将全局profit分为4个分位数
                    global_quartiles = pd.qcut(global_profit_dist, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    subset_quartiles = pd.qcut(subset_profit, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    
                    # 创建列联表
                    contingency_table = pd.crosstab(
                        pd.Series(['Subset'] * len(subset_quartiles), name='Group'),
                        subset_quartiles
                    )
                    
                    # 添加全局数据
                    global_counts = pd.Series(global_quartiles.value_counts()).reindex(['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    contingency_table.loc['Global'] = global_counts
                    
                    # 执行卡方检验
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
                    # 效应大小：Cramér's V
                    n = contingency_table.sum().sum()
                    min_dim = min(contingency_table.shape) - 1
                    cramers_v_h4 = np.sqrt(chi2_stat_h4 / (n * min_dim)) if n > 0 and min_dim > 0 else np.nan
                else:
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan

                    # 由于全局数据可能很大，我们抽样进行比较
                    if len(full_data) > 10000:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales'].sample(n=min(10000, len(full_data)), random_state=42)
                    else:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales']
                    
                    mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5 = stats.mannwhitneyu(subset_sales, global_sample, alternative='two-sided')
                    # 效应大小：排名双列相关
                    n1 = len(subset_sales)
                    n2 = len(global_sample)
                    effect_size_h5 = 1 - (2 * mw_stat_h5) / (n1 * n2)
                else:
                    mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # 存储结果
                results.append({
                    'Region': region,
                    'Product_Category': category,
                    'Customer_Segment': segment,
                    'Sample_Size': len(subset_data),
                    
                    # H1结果
                    'H1_t_stat': t_stat_h1,
                    'H1_p_value': p_value_h1,

                })

                    t_stat_h1, p_value_h1 = stats.ttest_1samp(subset_sales, global_sales_mean)
                    # 效应大小：Cohen's d
                    cohens_d_h1 = abs((subset_sales.mean() - global_sales_mean) / (subset_sales.std(ddof=1) if subset_sales.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 1))
                else:
                    t_stat_h1, p_value_h1, cohens_d_h1 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H2: 方差相等检验 (F检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 1 and global_sales_var > 0:
                    # 计算子集方差
                    subset_var = subset_sales.var(ddof=1)
                    # F检验：比较方差比
                    f_stat_h2 = subset_var / global_sales_var if global_sales_var > 0 else np.nan
                    # 计算p值：F分布
                    df1 = len(subset_sales) - 1
                    df2 = len(full_data) - 1
                    if f_stat_h2 > 0:
                        p_value_h2 = 2 * min(stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2), 1 - stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2))
                        # 效应大小：方差比的对数
                        effect_size_h2 = np.log(f_stat_h2)
                    else:
                        p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    f_stat_h2, p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H3: 分布匹配检验 (Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验)
                subset_profit = subset_data['Profit'].values
                if len(subset_profit) > 0 and len(global_profit_dist) > 0:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3 = stats.ks_2samp(subset_profit, global_profit_dist)
                    # 效应大小：KS统计量本身
                    effect_size_h3 = ks_stat_h3
                else:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3, effect_size_h3 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H4: 独立性检验 (卡方检验)
                # 创建列联表：子集的profit与全局profit分布比较
                # 由于需要分类变量，我们将profit分为分位数
                if len(subset_profit) > 3:  # 需要至少4个数据点才能分4个分位数
                    try:
                        # 将全局profit分为4个分位数
                        global_quartiles = pd.qcut(global_profit_dist, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'], duplicates='drop')
                        subset_quartiles = pd.qcut(subset_profit, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'], duplicates='drop')
                        
                        # 创建列联表
                        contingency_table = pd.crosstab(
                            pd.Series(['Subset'] * len(subset_quartiles), name='Group'),
                            subset_quartiles
                        )
                        
                        # 添加全局数据
                        global_counts = pd.Series(global_quartiles.value_counts()).reindex(['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                        contingency_table.loc['Global'] = global_counts
                        
                        # 检查列联表是否有足够的计数
                        if (contingency_table.values >= 5).all():
                            # 执行卡方检验
                            chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
                            # 效应大小：Cramér's V
                            n = contingency_table.sum().sum()
                            min_dim = min(contingency_table.shape) - 1
                            cramers_v_h4 = np.sqrt(chi2_stat_h4 / (n * min_dim)) if n > 0 and min_dim > 0 else np.nan
                        else:
                            chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                    except Exception as e:
                        chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H5: 中位数相等检验 (Mann-Whitney U检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 0:
                    # 将子集数据与全局数据（抽样）进行比较
                    # 由于全局数据可能很大，我们抽样进行比较
                    if len(full_data) > 10000:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales'].sample(n=min(10000, len(full_data)), random_state=42)
                    else:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales']
                    
                    try:
                        mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5 = stats.mannwhitneyu(subset_sales, global_sample, alternative='two-sided')
                        # 效应大小：排名双列相关
                        n1 = len(subset_sales)
                        n2 = len(global_sample)
                        effect_size_h5 = 1 - (2 * mw_stat_h5) / (n1 * n2)
                    except Exception as e:
                        mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # 存储结果
                results.append({
                    'Region': region,
                    'Product_Category': category,
                    'Customer_Segment': segment,
                    'Sample_Size': len(subset_data),
                    
                    # H1结果
                    'H1_t_stat': t_stat_h1,

                    # H2结果

                    # H3结果

                # 显示该子集的部分结果

                if len(subset_sales) > 1 and global_sales_var > 0:
                    # 计算子集方差
                    subset_var = subset_sales.var(ddof=1)
                    # F检验：比较方差比
                    f_stat_h2 = subset_var / global_sales_var if global_sales_var > 0 else np.nan
                    # 计算p值：F分布
                    df1 = len(subset_sales) - 1
                    df2 = len(full_data) - 1
                    if f_stat_h2 > 0:
                        p_value_h2 = 2 * min(stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2), 1 - stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2))
                        # 效应大小：方差比的对数
                        effect_size_h2 = np.log(f_stat_h2)
                    else:
                        p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    f_stat_h2, p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H3: 分布匹配检验 (Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验)
                subset_profit = subset_data['Profit'].values
                if len(subset_profit) > 0 and len(global_profit_dist) > 0:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3 = stats.ks_2samp(subset_profit, global_profit_dist)
                    # 效应大小：KS统计量本身
                    effect_size_h3 = ks_stat_h3
                else:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3, effect_size_h3 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H4: 独立性检验 (卡方检验)
                # 创建列联表：子集的profit与全局profit分布比较
                # 由于需要分类变量，我们将profit分为分位数
                if len(subset_profit) > 0:
                    # 将全局profit分为4个分位数
                    global_quartiles = pd.qcut(global_profit_dist, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    subset_quartiles = pd.qcut(subset_profit, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    
                    # 创建列联表
                    contingency_table = pd.crosstab(
                        pd.Series(['Subset'] * len(subset_quartiles), name='Group'),
                        subset_quartiles
                    )
                    
                    # 添加全局数据
                    global_counts = pd.Series(global_quartiles.value_counts()).reindex(['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    contingency_table.loc['Global'] = global_counts
                    
                    # 执行卡方检验
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
                    # 效应大小：Cramér's V
                    n = contingency_table.sum().sum()
                    min_dim = min(contingency_table.shape) - 1
                    cramers_v_h4 = np.sqrt(chi2_stat_h4 / (n * min_dim)) if n > 0 and min_dim > 0 else np.nan
                else:
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan

                    n1 = len(subset_sales)
                    n2 = len(global_sample)
                    effect_size_h5 = 1 - (2 * mw_stat_h5) / (n1 * n2)
                else:

                # 存储结果
                results.append({

conn.close()

# 获取全局统计数据用于比较
global_sales_mean = full_data['Sales'].mean()
global_sales_median = full_data['Sales'].median()
global_sales_var = full_data['Sales'].var(ddof=1)  # 样本方差
global_profit_dist = full_data['Profit']

print(f"\n全局统计数据:")
print(f"全局Sales均值: {global_sales_mean:.4f}")
print(f"全局Sales中位数: {global_sales_median:.4f}")
print(f"全局Sales方差: {global_sales_var:.4f}")
print(f"全局Profit分布样本数: {len(global_profit_dist)}")

# 获取所有唯一组合
unique_regions = full_data['Region'].dropna().unique()
unique_categories = full_data['Product Category'].dropna().unique()

print(f"\n发现 {len(unique_regions)} 个Region: {unique_regions}")

print(f"发现 {len(unique_segments)} 个Customer Segment: {unique_segments}")

# 为每个子集执行假设检验
results = []

for region in unique_regions:
    for category in unique_categories:
        for segment in unique_segments:
            # 筛选子集数据
            subset_data = full_data[
                (full_data['Region'] == region) & 
                (full_data['Product Category'] == category) & 
                (full_data['Customer Segment'] == segment)
            ]
            
            if len(subset_data) > 0:
                print(f"\n处理子集: Region={region}, Product Category={category}, Customer Segment={segment}")
                print(f"子集大小: {len(subset_data)}")
                
                # H1: 均值相等检验 (t检验)
                subset_sales = subset_data['Sales'].values
                if len(subset_sales) > 1:
                    # 使用单样本t检验比较子集均值与全局均值
                    t_stat_h1, p_value_h1 = stats.ttest_1samp(subset_sales, global_sales_mean)
                    # 效应大小：Cohen's d
                    cohens_d_h1 = abs((subset_sales.mean() - global_sales_mean) / (subset_sales.std(ddof=1) if subset_sales.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 1))
                else:
                    t_stat_h1, p_value_h1, cohens_d_h1 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H2: 方差相等检验 (F检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 1 and global_sales_var > 0:
                    # 计算子集方差
                    subset_var = subset_sales.var(ddof=1)
                    # F检验：比较方差比
                    f_stat_h2 = subset_var / global_sales_var if global_sales_var > 0 else np.nan
                    # 计算p值：F分布
                    df1 = len(subset_sales) - 1
                    df2 = len(full_data) - 1
                    if f_stat_h2 > 0:
                        p_value_h2 = 2 * min(stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2), 1 - stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2))
                        # 效应大小：方差比的对数
                        effect_size_h2 = np.log(f_stat_h2)
                    else:
                        p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    f_stat_h2, p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H3: 分布匹配检验 (Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验)
                subset_profit = subset_data['Profit'].values
                if len(subset_profit) > 0 and len(global_profit_dist) > 0:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3 = stats.ks_2samp(subset_profit, global_profit_dist)
                    # 效应大小：KS统计量本身
                    effect_size_h3 = ks_stat_h3
                else:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3, effect_size_h3 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan

                # 由于需要分类变量，我们将profit分为分位数
                if len(subset_profit) > 3:  # 需要至少4个数据点才能分4个分位数
                    try:
                        # 将全局profit分为4个分位数
                        global_quartiles = pd.qcut(global_profit_dist, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'], duplicates='drop')
                        subset_quartiles = pd.qcut(subset_profit, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'], duplicates='drop')
                        
                        # 创建列联表
                        contingency_table = pd.crosstab(
                            pd.Series(['Subset'] * len(subset_quartiles), name='Group'),
                            subset_quartiles
                        )
                        
                        # 添加全局数据
                        global_counts = pd.Series(global_quartiles.value_counts()).reindex(['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                        contingency_table.loc['Global'] = global_counts
                        
                        # 检查列联表是否有足够的计数
                        if (contingency_table.values >= 5).all():
                            # 执行卡方检验
                            chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
                            # 效应大小：Cramér's V
                            n = contingency_table.sum().sum()
                            min_dim = min(contingency_table.shape) - 1
                            cramers_v_h4 = np.sqrt(chi2_stat_h4 / (n * min_dim)) if n > 0 and min_dim > 0 else np.nan
                        else:
                            chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                    except Exception as e:
                        chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H5: 中位数相等检验 (Mann-Whitney U检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 0:
                    # 将子集数据与全局数据（抽样）进行比较
                    # 由于全局数据可能很大，我们抽样进行比较
                    if len(full_data) > 10000:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales'].sample(n=min(10000, len(full_data)), random_state=42)
                    else:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales']
                    
                    try:
                        mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5 = stats.mannwhitneyu(subset_sales, global_sample, alternative='two-sided')
                        # 效应大小：排名双列相关
                        n1 = len(subset_sales)
                        n2 = len(global_sample)
                        effect_size_h5 = 1 - (2 * mw_stat_h5) / (n1 * n2)
                    except Exception as e:
                        mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # 存储结果
                results.append({
                    'Region': region,
                    'Product_Category': category,
                    'Customer_Segment': segment,
                    'Sample_Size': len(subset_data),
                    
                    # H1结果
                    'H1_t_stat': t_stat_h1,
                    'H1_p_value': p_value_h1,
                    'H1_effect_size': cohens_d_h1,
                    
                    # H2结果
                    'H2_f_stat': f_stat_h2,

                    # H3结果

                })

                print(f"  H5: U={mw_stat_h5:.4f}, p={p_value_h5:.4f}, r={effect_size_h5:.4f}")

conn.close()

# 获取全局统计数据用于比较
global_sales_mean = full_data['Sales'].mean()
global_sales_median = full_data['Sales'].median()
global_sales_var = full_data['Sales'].var(ddof=1)  # 样本方差
global_profit_dist = full_data['Profit']

print(f"\n全局统计数据:")
print(f"全局Sales均值: {global_sales_mean:.4f}")
print(f"全局Sales中位数: {global_sales_median:.4f}")
print(f"全局Sales方差: {global_sales_var:.4f}")
print(f"全局Profit分布样本数: {len(global_profit_dist)}")

# 获取所有唯一组合
unique_regions = full_data['Region'].dropna().unique()
unique_categories = full_data['Product Category'].dropna().unique()
unique_segments = full_data['Customer Segment'].dropna().unique()

print(f"\n发现 {len(unique_regions)} 个Region: {unique_regions}")
print(f"发现 {len(unique_categories)} 个Product Category: {unique_categories}")
print(f"发现 {len(unique_segments)} 个Customer Segment: {unique_segments}")

# 为每个子集执行假设检验
results = []

for region in unique_regions:
    for category in unique_categories:
        for segment in unique_segments:
            # 筛选子集数据
            subset_data = full_data[
                (full_data['Region'] == region) & 
                (full_data['Product Category'] == category) & 
                (full_data['Customer Segment'] == segment)
            ]
            
            if len(subset_data) > 0:
                print(f"\n处理子集: Region={region}, Product Category={category}, Customer Segment={segment}")
                print(f"子集大小: {len(subset_data)}")
                
                # H1: 均值相等检验 (t检验)
                subset_sales = subset_data['Sales'].values
                if len(subset_sales) > 1:
                    # 两独立样本t检验，比较子集均值与全局均值
                    # 注意：由于我们只有全局样本均值，没有全局原始数据，这里使用单样本t检验
                    t_stat_h1, p_value_h1 = stats.ttest_1samp(subset_sales, global_sales_mean)
                    # 效应大小：Cohen's d
                    cohens_d_h1 = abs((subset_sales.mean() - global_sales_mean) / (subset_sales.std(ddof=1) if subset_sales.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 1))
                else:
                    t_stat_h1, p_value_h1, cohens_d_h1 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H2: 方差相等检验 (F检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 1 and global_sales_var > 0:
                    # 计算子集方差
                    subset_var = subset_sales.var(ddof=1)
                    # F检验：比较方差比
                    f_stat_h2 = subset_var / global_sales_var if global_sales_var > 0 else np.nan
                    # 计算p值：F分布
                    df1 = len(subset_sales) - 1
                    df2 = len(full_data) - 1
                    if f_stat_h2 > 0:
                        p_value_h2 = 2 * min(stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2), 1 - stats.f.cdf(f_stat_h2, df1, df2))
                        # 效应大小：方差比的对数
                        effect_size_h2 = np.log(f_stat_h2)
                    else:
                        p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    f_stat_h2, p_value_h2, effect_size_h2 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H3: 分布匹配检验 (Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验)
                subset_profit = subset_data['Profit'].values
                if len(subset_profit) > 0 and len(global_profit_dist) > 0:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3 = stats.ks_2samp(subset_profit, global_profit_dist)
                    # 效应大小：KS统计量本身
                    effect_size_h3 = ks_stat_h3
                else:
                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3, effect_size_h3 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H4: 独立性检验 (卡方检验)
                # 创建列联表：子集的profit与全局profit分布比较
                # 由于需要分类变量，我们将profit分为分位数
                if len(subset_profit) > 0:
                    # 将全局profit分为4个分位数
                    global_quartiles = pd.qcut(global_profit_dist, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    subset_quartiles = pd.qcut(subset_profit, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    
                    # 创建列联表
                    contingency_table = pd.crosstab(
                        pd.Series(['Subset'] * len(subset_quartiles), name='Group'),
                        subset_quartiles
                    )
                    
                    # 添加全局数据
                    global_counts = pd.Series(global_quartiles.value_counts()).reindex(['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                    contingency_table.loc['Global'] = global_counts
                    
                    # 执行卡方检验
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
                    # 效应大小：Cramér's V
                    n = contingency_table.sum().sum()
                    min_dim = min(contingency_table.shape) - 1
                    cramers_v_h4 = np.sqrt(chi2_stat_h4 / (n * min_dim)) if n > 0 and min_dim > 0 else np.nan
                else:
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H5: 中位数相等检验 (Mann-Whitney U检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 0:
                    # 将子集数据与全局数据（抽样）进行比较
                    # 由于全局数据可能很大，我们抽样进行比较
                    if len(full_data) > 10000:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales'].sample(n=min(10000, len(full_data)), random_state=42)
                    else:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales']
                    
                    mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5 = stats.mannwhitneyu(subset_sales, global_sample, alternative='two-sided')
                    # 效应大小：排名双列相关
                    n1 = len(subset_sales)
                    n2 = len(global_sample)
                    effect_size_h5 = 1 - (2 * mw_stat_h5) / (n1 * n2)
                else:
                    mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # 存储结果
                results.append({
                    'Region': region,
                    'Product_Category': category,
                    'Customer_Segment': segment,
                    'Sample_Size': len(subset_data),
                    
                    # H1结果
                    'H1_t_stat': t_stat_h1,
                    'H1_p_value': p_value_h1,
                    'H1_effect_size': cohens_d_h1,
                    
                    # H2结果
                    'H2_f_stat': f_stat_h2,
                    'H2_p_value': p_value_h2,
                    'H2_effect_size': effect_size_h2,
                    
                    # H3结果
                    'H3_ks_stat': ks_stat_h3,
                    'H3_p_value': p_value_h3,
                    'H3_effect_size': effect_size_h3,
                    
                    # H4结果
                    'H4_chi2_stat': chi2_stat_h4,
                    'H4_p_value': p_value_h4,
                    'H4_effect_size': cramers_v_h4,
                    
                    # H5结果
                    'H5_mw_stat': mw_stat_h5,
                    'H5_p_value': p_value_h5,
                    'H5_effect_size': effect_size_h5
                })
                
                # 显示该子集的部分结果
                print(f"  H1: t={t_stat_h1:.4f}, p={p_value_h1:.4f}, d={cohens_d_h1:.4f}")
                print(f"  H2: F={f_stat_h2:.4f}, p={p_value_h2:.4f}, log(VR)={effect_size_h2:.4f}")
                print(f"  H3: KS={ks_stat_h3:.4f}, p={p_value_h3:.4f}, KS={effect_size_h3:.4f}")
                print(f"  H4: χ²={chi2_stat_h4:.4f}, p={p_value_h4:.4f}, V={cramers_v_h4:.4f}")
                print(f"  H5: U={mw_stat_h5:.4f}, p={p_value_h5:.4f}, r={effect_size_h5:.4f}")

                    ks_stat_h3, p_value_h3, effect_size_h3 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H4: 独立性检验 (卡方检验)
                # 创建列联表：子集的profit与全局profit分布比较
                # 由于需要分类变量，我们将profit分为分位数
                if len(subset_profit) > 3:  # 需要至少4个数据点才能分4个分位数
                    try:
                        # 将全局profit分为4个分位数
                        global_quartiles = pd.qcut(global_profit_dist, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'], duplicates='drop')
                        subset_quartiles = pd.qcut(subset_profit, q=4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'], duplicates='drop')
                        
                        # 创建列联表
                        contingency_table = pd.crosstab(
                            pd.Series(['Subset'] * len(subset_quartiles), name='Group'),
                            subset_quartiles
                        )
                        
                        # 添加全局数据
                        global_counts = pd.Series(global_quartiles.value_counts()).reindex(['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
                        contingency_table.loc['Global'] = global_counts
                        
                        # 检查列联表是否有足够的计数
                        if (contingency_table.values >= 5).all():
                            # 执行卡方检验
                            chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, dof, expected = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
                            # 效应大小：Cramér's V
                            n = contingency_table.sum().sum()
                            min_dim = min(contingency_table.shape) - 1
                            cramers_v_h4 = np.sqrt(chi2_stat_h4 / (n * min_dim)) if n > 0 and min_dim > 0 else np.nan
                        else:
                            chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                    except Exception as e:
                        chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    chi2_stat_h4, p_value_h4, cramers_v_h4 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # H5: 中位数相等检验 (Mann-Whitney U检验)
                if len(subset_sales) > 0:
                    # 将子集数据与全局数据（抽样）进行比较
                    # 由于全局数据可能很大，我们抽样进行比较
                    if len(full_data) > 10000:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales'].sample(n=min(10000, len(full_data)), random_state=42)
                    else:
                        global_sample = full_data['Sales']
                    
                    try:
                        mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5 = stats.mannwhitneyu(subset_sales, global_sample, alternative='two-sided')
                        # 效应大小：排名双列相关
                        n1 = len(subset_sales)
                        n2 = len(global_sample)
                        effect_size_h5 = 1 - (2 * mw_stat_h5) / (n1 * n2)
                    except Exception as e:
                        mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                else:
                    mw_stat_h5, p_value_h5, effect_size_h5 = np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
                
                # 存储结果
                results.append({
                    'Region': region,
                    'Product_Category': category,
                    'Customer_Segment': segment,
                    'Sample_Size': len(subset_data),
                    
                    # H1结果
                    'H1_t_stat': t_stat_h1,
                    'H1_p_value': p_value_h1,
                    'H1_effect_size': cohens_d_h1,
                    
                    # H2结果
                    'H2_f_stat': f_stat_h2,
                    'H2_p_value': p_value_h2,
                    'H2_effect_size': effect_size_h2,
                    
                    # H3结果
                    'H3_ks_stat': ks_stat_h3,
                    'H3_p_value': p_value_h3,
                    'H3_effect_size': effect_size_h3,
                    
                    # H4结果
                    'H4_chi2_stat': chi2_stat_h4,
                    'H4_p_value': p_value_h4,
                    'H4_effect_size': cramers_v_h4,
                    
                    # H5结果
                    'H5_mw_stat': mw_stat_h5,
                    'H5_p_value': p_value_h5,
                    'H5_effect_size': effect_size_h5
                })
                
                # 显示该子集的部分结果
                print(f"  H1: t={t_stat_h1:.4f}, p={p_value_h1:.4f}, d={cohens_d_h1:.4f}")
                print(f"  H2: F={f_stat_h2:.4f}, p={p_value_h2:.4f}, log(VR)={effect_size_h2:.4f}")
                print(f"  H3: KS={ks_stat_h3:.4f}, p={p_value_h3:.4f}, KS={effect_size_h3:.4f}")
                print(f"  H4: χ²={chi2_stat_h4:.4f}, p={p_value_h4:.4f}, V={cramers_v_h4:.4f}")
                print(f"  H5: U={mw_stat_h5:.4f}, p={p_value_h5:.4f}, r={effect_size_h5:.4f}")

# 创建结果DataFrame
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
